changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[AttributeDetail] as select A.ObjectType, A.ObjectID, A.AttributeTypeID, A.ID, A.ParentID, T.Name, C.Name as AttributeTypeCategory, T.ShowNameInTree, A.DisplayValue as FormattedValue from Attribute A inner join AttributeType T on A.AttributeTypeID = T.ID left join AttributeTypeCategory C on C.ID = T.AttributeTypeCategoryID
